column1: # streaming_expected.tsv — per-family expected class under the memory-ceiling
# gate (tests/cli/streaming_ceiling). Columns: family<TAB>expected.
#   streams  = validate --ndjson <fixture> completes rc=0 inside the ceiling
#              (video: 2GiB+ fixture / 512MiB ceiling; audio: 256MiB+ / 64MiB;
#              cgroup MemoryMax + MemorySwapMax=0, systemd-run --user --scope)
#   resident = validate is OOM-killed (or allocator-fails) at the ceiling —
#              it holds ~the whole file in anonymous memory
# THE CLAIM-IMPLIES-PROOF MECHANISM: this file is the honest record of
# observed reality, and the gate FAILS on divergence in EITHER direction.
# When a codec family is converted to true streaming, flip its row to
# `streams` IN THE SAME COMMIT as the conversion — the gate is the proof the
# claim needs. The capability matrix consumes this manifest.
# Baseline witnessed 2026-08-15, binary 864c97fd1, NixOS x86_64 (Thelio),
# cgroup mode (observed class, rc, wall secs at the ceiling):
#   h264_mp4   streams   rc=0    6s     h265_mp4   resident  rc=137  83s
#   h265_mkv   streams   rc=0    121s   vp9_webm   resident  rc=137  41s
#   theora_ogv resident  rc=137  117s   mkv_cc     (skipped: no mkvmerge)
#   mp3        streams   rc=0    23s    flac       streams   rc=0    21s
#   aac_m4a    streams   rc=0    1s     opus_ogg   resident  rc=137  15s
#   vorbis_ogg resident  rc=137  13s    wav        streams   rc=0    1s
# CAVEAT on today's `streams` rows: they certify BOUNDED RESIDENT MEMORY,
# not an architected incremental decode — validate's file pages stay
# clean/evictable, so the kernel reclaims them under cgroup pressure and the
# run completes slowly (h264_mp4: ~80s cold cache vs ~6s warm; user CPU ~1s).
# The N-ladder (tests/cli/streaming_ladder) separately witnesses that this
# memory is NOT released between files in a batch (peak RSS grows ~linearly
# with N) — the streaming conversions must flip that baseline to `flat`.
# mkv_cc was UNWITNESSED until 2026-08-19 (mkvmerge absent on the baseline
# box). Its `streams` guess — inferred from the sibling h265_mkv demux path —
# was WRONG: first real witness (mkvtoolnix in dev shell, binary 2b021ad3)
# observed RESIDENT, rc=137 at 4s under the 512MiB ceiling. zlib
# ContentCompression block decompression holds file-proportional anonymous
# memory; the honest row below records that. Conversion is #23 follow-up work.
